A '''mission''' was undertaken by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] agent [[Myri Antilles]] in [[44 ABY]] to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Galactic Princess]]'' to investigate whether the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Oobolo]], was engaging in criminal activity. Myri's father, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], was forced to come rescue her when her [[recording crystal]]s were jammed, cutting her off from GAS personnel, but the crystals were able to collect evidence against Oobolo, and the ''Princess'' was tagged by a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] cruiser nearby before it escaped.
